CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructKeyExists

Returns TRUE if the given key exists in the structure.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructKeyExists(structure, key)

Parameters

structure
The structure to search.
key
The key name to look for (not case-sensitive).

Returns

TRUE (YES) or FALSE (NO).

Usage

Use this before StructFind or StructUpdate, which throw an exception for a missing key. Unlike IsDefined, the key name can be any string, including one with spaces.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Inventory = StructNew()>
<CFSET Inventory.Modems = 12>
<CFSET Inventory["Zip Disks"] = 40>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<CFLOOP LIST="Modems,zip disks,Pagers" INDEX="Item">
<TR><TD>#Item#</TD>
<TD><CFIF StructKeyExists(Inventory, Item)>#Inventory[Item]# in stock<CFELSE>not carried</CFIF></TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

StructFind, IsDefined, StructKeyList
